problems.form_value: what_was_assigned: 'LLM Guidance (five associated words per cue word, no solution)'. arms[LLM Guidance]: 'listed five associated words for each cue word, without the solution'. how_used: 'LLM Guidance listed associated words and encouraged participants to find the link (coach)'.
problems.source_says: The paper says only that GPT-4o was told not to give the solution directly (p. 9: 'The model was instructed not to provide the solution directly'. Figure 12: 'do not directly give the solution'). Its own sample of a guidance response contains the solution word. For flake, mobile, cone, the answer is snow, and the guidance lists 'snow' first among the words for 'flake'. So this arm could show participants the answer word without a label. Supported wording: five associated words per cue word, with GPT-4o instructed not to give the solution directly. The same sample bears on the '(coach)' label in how_used, because codebook Section 6 defines coach as AI that supplies no content, and this arm supplies candidate words. The role field records the standard arm, so no coded value changes. Criterion 1 is unaffected.
problems.quote: Possible associated words for "flake" are snow, cereal, skin, coconut, and pastry.
problems.locator: PDF p. 18, Appendix B.2, Table 2, row 'flake, mobile, cone (snow)', LLM Guidance column; PDF p. 9, Section 4.1.1, LLM Guidance entry; PDF p. 16, Figure 12

confirmed.statement: (b) Experiment 1 assigns GPT-4o material for the participant's own AUT answers. List of Ideas shows seven GPT-4o uses sampled from a pool of 20 per object, 'which they could freely use in their responses'. List of Strategies shows seven SCAMPER strategies and 'refrained from sharing explicit answers to the task'. Figure 3 puts the AI panel beside the idea-entry box, with the note 'You are allowed to freely use the following AI suggestion for your answers'. Every arm's own ideas are scored (9,457 ideas), so the conditions do not differ only in whose output gets evaluated.

summary: The PDF states random assignment for both experiments (Figure 1 caption, Introduction, Sections 3.1.1 and 4.1.1, and the 'Randomize Condition, 33.3% each' step in Figures 2 and 7), and in both between-subjects designs individual Prolific participants got no AI, a standard GPT-4o output (seven ideas or the answer), or a coach-like GPT-4o output (seven SCAMPER strategies or associated words) for their own exposure-round work, so criterion 1 holds. One detail is not supported: the form says the Experiment 2 LLM Guidance arm gave 'no solution', but the paper says only that GPT-4o was instructed not to give it directly, and its own sample in Table 2 (p. 18) lists the solution word 'snow' among the associated words for 'flake'.
